summary: Master the art of marketing communications and media planning with our specialized course. Gain practical knowledge and advance your career in the field.
lede: Marketing communications training covers planning consistent brand messages and selecting media for campaign goals. It is for media planners, marketing and communications specialists, coordinators, brand managers, and analysts who develop, run, or measure campaigns. Learners practice audience segmentation, creative brief development, PESO channel scheduling, media budgeting, and campaign measurement, including reach, frequency, attribution, and performance reporting.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the design, execution, and measurement of brand messaging and media investment.
audience: Account Executive at a creative agency
modules: Integrated Marketing Communications and SOSTAC Foundations
The Media Planning Process and PESO Framework
Digital Media, Programmatic, and AI Integration
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of marketing principles and be familiar with standard digital platforms. No prior coding or advanced statistical knowledge is required. A laptop is recommended for hands-on exercises involving media planning templates and analytics tools.
